synopsis: ISO 18497 Parts 1–4, 2024 editions, were published in July 2024 and provide off-road standards for agricultural obstacle protection [f7187, f1099]. The family covers machine design principles, obstacle-protection design principles, and verification methods including test objects [f450]. Chapter 1 identifies it as the nearest published example of an off-road sector putting perception test objects into a standard, while Chapter 9 calls it a close cousin of the heavy off-road collision-mitigation function under study [f451, f7190]. The supplied facts describe the family collectively; they do not establish Part 3-specific requirements or direct applicability to the heavy off-road system [f450, f1099, f7190].

relations.note: Specifies the design and verification scope of agricultural obstacle-protection standards.
Inclusion of verification test objects supports the perception-test-object precedent.
Agricultural off-road obstacle protection explains the family's relevance to heavy off-road collision mitigation.
Obstacle-protection design and verification scope supports the close-cousin characterization.
July 2024 publication establishes availability of the cited published precedent.
